24| // run sends beats on the configured interval until cancelled. A send
25| // failure is counted and skipped, never retried inline: the next beat
26| // is a fresher summary than a delayed copy of the last one, and the
27| // registry treats missed beats as the health signal anyway.
28| func (h *heartbeater) run(ctx context.Context) {
29| 	t := time.NewTicker(h.every)
30| 	defer t.Stop()
31| 	for {
32| 		select {
33| 		case <-ctx.Done():
34| 			return
35| 		case <-t.C:
36| 			if err := h.send(ctx, h.snapshot()); err != nil {
37| 				h.missed++
38| 			}
39| 		}
40| 	}
41| }

1| package collector
2| 
3| import (
4| 	"sync"
5| 	"time"
6| )
7| 
8| // registry tracks known collectors by their last beat. A collector
9| // expires after a configured number of consecutive missed beats;
10| // expiry is measured in beats, not wall time, so retuning the beat
11| // interval never silently changes how long a dead collector lingers.
12| type registry struct {
13| 	mu        sync.Mutex
14| 	entries   map[string]entry
15| 	missLimit int
16| }
17| 
18| type entry struct {
19| 	lastBeat time.Time
20| 	misses   int
21| 	restart  string // restart annotation, shown inline with expiry warnings
22| }
23| 
24| // observe records one beat and clears the miss counter. Restart
25| // annotations ride the first beat after a restart so expiry warnings
26| // during a rolling restart carry their context.
27| func (r *registry) observe(id string, b beat) {
28| 	r.mu.Lock()
29| 	defer r.mu.Unlock()
30| 	e := r.entries[id]
31| 	e.lastBeat = time.Now()
32| 	e.misses = 0
33| 	r.entries[id] = e
34| }
35| 
36| // sweep advances miss counters and expires entries past the limit.
37| func (r *registry) sweep() {
38| 	r.mu.Lock()
39| 	defer r.mu.Unlock()
40| 	for id, e := range r.entries {
41| 		if e.misses >= r.missLimit {
42| 			delete(r.entries, id)
43| 		}
44| 	}
45| }

2| 
3| Collectors register with the daemon and report through the periodic
4| heartbeat, which carries the health summary: queue depth, last-batch
5| age, and the running config revision.
6| 
7| ## Registration
8| 
9| New collectors use the token handshake against the registration
10| endpoint. Fleets behind a proxy need the forwarded-address stanza or
11| registration loops; see the migration notes for the workaround.
12| 
13| ## Health
14| 
15| The heartbeat interval is deployment config. Expiry is counted in
16| consecutive missed beats, so retuning the interval does not silently
17| change how long a dead collector lingers in the registry. Restart
18| annotations keep rolling restarts from reading as expirations.
